title: When Continual Learning Moves to Memory: A Study of Experience Reuse in LLM Agents
core_contribution: Proves that abstract insights in external memory prevent 'procedural mimicry' and facilitate better cross-task experience reuse compared to raw trajectories.
technical_intuition: Raw trajectories lead to negative transfer due to task-specific procedural mismatch; abstract insights preserve functional guidance, enabling stability-plasticity balance.

visual_logic.slide_1: Contrast of large storage vs fragmented memory
